payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image show the source woman with a helmet-related change that is visibly incomplete—for example, a helmet being placed but not yet on her head?
node.criteria: Pass only if visible evidence shows a helmet-related change to the source woman that is in progress and not yet complete. Fail if no helmet-related change is visible, or if the helmet is already visibly on her head as a complete result. Unknown if the woman, helmet, or placement cannot be judged.
node.binding: Compare the edited image with the source, identify the same woman, and assess only visible helmet placement on her head. A helmet merely nearby, on another subject, or already present in the source is not progress. Do not infer incompleteness from uncertainty.
